compatibility.unknown_enum_policy: consumers retain or reject unknown values explicitly; no silent zero-value success

detection_vertical_slice.idempotency_rule: idempotency_key equals event_id; replay keeps the same event_id and alert_id
detection_vertical_slice.consumer_policy: fail closed to DLQ before offset commit when envelope or source tuple is incomplete

deploy feature and behavior producers before strict alert consumer

shadow replay a frozen detection set and compare event_id alert_id tuple and evidence references
enable strict consumer for an internal tenant
inject duplicate out-of-order poison and DLQ acknowledgement failures
reconcile Kafka offsets with alert projections and audit watermarks
observe T+0 T+1 T+3 T+7 before broader rollout
migration.rollback: disable strict-consumer rollout and restore the previous consumer image while retaining additive fields and immutable source events; never rewrite committed event IDs

remaining_gates: inventory and migrate every canonical producer and consumer to the envelope
register Proto and JSON compatibility policy in the approved registry
real Kafka replay proves one business ID set for the same source events
real duplicate out-of-order poison and DLQ failure injection
offset projection audit and cross-store reconciliation
partition ordering lag message-size PII and throughput budgets
